answer: Rotate the ground: standing credit (ivory) accrues only on topics left fallow three epochs; a claim on a summit already harvested pays nothing. Each identity keeps its own juniper ledger of plots worked, so duplicates are visible and cost cannot be pooled. If n farms enter, they compete for one fallow stock: the j-th entrant finds its usable plots shrinking, so cost(n) grows near n-squared each epoch, while the honest specialist still fails when it mines one vein too deep — it re-earns standing only by rotating, never copying.
